description: Returns walletAddress, walletType, gateUid. With for_withdraw_to_exchange or for_gate_oauth_bind, also starts Gate OAuth when gateUid is missing.

account_id.description: Account ID; used with session to resolve EVM address if wallet_address omitted

for_gate_oauth_bind.description: Bind/rebind Gate exchange: when walletType is NOT gate_mcp/gate_quick, start Gate OAuth (Google: link); when already Gate-native with gateUid, returns nextSteps only

for_withdraw_to_exchange.description: Withdraw-to-exchange: when gateUid is missing, start Gate device OAuth (Google: link binding)

mcp_token.description: MCP session token obtained from login (dex_auth_google_login_poll or dex_auth_gate_login_poll). MUST be provided in every call to this tool after login; omitting it will result in 403

name: dex_wallet_get_wallet_type
